detail.longDescription: Anthropic built Scion, its own version control system, as AI-driven development pushed its engineering infrastructure to new limits. 🫡 The bigger lesson? Faster code generation can shift bottlenecks to source control, CI/CD, testing, and code review. Engineering teams need infrastructure that scales with how they build software.
